description:
Edited interpretation texts for a chart, no AI at request time. `keys` is a comma list of up to 64: `sun.aries` (planet in sign, also `chiron`, `ascendant`), `moon.h4` (planet in house), `sun_moon.trine` (major aspect between two of Sun..Pluto). `lang` is required; a text that does not exist in that language is listed in `missing`, never replaced by another language. Planet in sign covers 20 languages; houses and aspects are being written. Plain text, paragraphs separated by a blank line.

[Group: Reference]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/natal-texts]
[Required: keys, lang]
[Cost: 10 credits (Tier 1)]

Keys with no text in the requested `lang` come back listed in `missing`, not in `texts`. Do not invent, translate or guess a replacement body for a key that comes back in `missing`; report it as unavailable.

keys.description: Comma list of up to 64 distinct keys: `<body>.<sign>` (planet in sign, also `chiron`, `ascendant`, `north_node`, `south_node`, `lilith`), `<body>.h<1-12>` (planet in house, also `chiron`, `lilith`), `<body>_<body>.<aspect>` (conjunction, sextile, square, trine, opposition between two of Sun..Pluto), `pattern.<name>` (t_square, grand_trine, grand_cross, stellium, yod, kite; kind `pattern`, a general text for the figure, the planets are yours to list). Nodes, Lilith in sign and patterns are written in every language listed for `lang`.

lang.description: Language of the texts. No fallback: a text missing in this language is listed in `missing`.

name: astroway_reference_natal_texts
title: Natal texts (static)
